name: @v1d/arch-check
description: A repo's architecture rules as data (arch.config.json): file size, line length, module edges, forbidden patterns, duplicates, counts, folders and file names, WHAT/WHY comments judged by AMUX, with a baseline that may only shrink. The guard (guard/): module doors, dependencies and cycles read from the imports of TypeScript, JavaScript, Svelte, Python and Kotlin, and a ratchet whose every raise is a named decision. No dependencies; TypeScript 5 is needed only for the JavaScript reader.
